question: The order of battle browser: oobbrowser and split_window, its rows, what opens and shuts it, its buttons, the tree, the drag and what it posts; what COOBChange is.

structs.name: COOBBrowser
structs.comment: The order of battle browser window, the in-game screen's +0x1360 (its slot 105 answers the object). Built by CInGameIdler::Enter, opened and shut by the screen's slot 104. Two list boxes, the `oobbrowser` window and its `split_window`, with one pool of rows per list.
structs.evidence: `operator new(0x304)` at 0x65F03A and the constructor at 0x737920 writing the vftable 0x15D6E04 and initialising to +0x300 (+0xC0 dwords). Base CReloadableInterface at +0 by RTTI.

structs.name: COOBUnitEntry
structs.comment: One row of the browser's list: the window `oob_unit_entry` with its child `oob_actual_entry`. A row holds the unit as a CRef (+0x28), not a pointer, and is drawn at x = level * 16. Rows are pooled and reused, never destroyed until the browser is.
structs.evidence: `operator new(0x168)` at FUN_0073b800 and the constructor at 0x735D60 writing vftables 0x15D6D70 and 0x15D6DA4 and every field listed here.

structs.name: COOBChange
structs.comment: **Not a drag record and nothing to do with the browser.** A country-history entry: a dated `oob = ...` line, whose slot 7 sets CCountry::oob_file (+0x58). `this+0x10` keeps the previous file and `this+0x2C` the new one, the two arms of slot 7's direction flag as on the other *Change entries.
structs.evidence: RTTI base CCountryHistoryEntry; slot 7 decompiled (0x5EFB60) assigns the file strings at +0x2C/+0x10 to country+0x58, this+0xC being the country. Only three slots of its own in the table 0x15C9B74. No caller of its constructor in the browser code. What would show it wrong: a reference from the browser's functions; there is none.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::COOBBrowser
addresses.comment: Makes the browser: the file name through the reloadable-interface base, wires nine glues (+0x178 collapse, +0x1A4 uncollapse, +0x1D0 and +0x1FC the split window's, +0x228 focus, +0x254 split focus, +0x280 theatre forces, +0x2AC split, +0x2D8 match views), calls Rebuild (slot 0), loads the two floating drag templates `oob_unit_entry` (+0xD8) and `oob_leader_entry` (+0xDC), hides them and closes the browser. One caller, CInGameIdler::Enter (0x65F057).
addresses.evidence: Read whole, listing and decompilation agree (0x737920-0x738005, `ret 8`). Ghidra's RTTI had called this `COOBBrowser_2` and the destructor `COOBBrowser`; the vftable and field writes here settle which is which.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::~COOBBrowser
addresses.comment: Destroys every pooled row of both lists (the vectors at +0xA8 and +0xB8, 0x10 apart), resets the nine glues and frees the two queues +0x148/+0x158.
addresses.evidence: Writes the class's own vftable at entry and tears down the fields the constructor makes. Ghidra's RTTI name `COOBBrowser::COOBBrowser` at this address is wrong (it is the one called by the deleting destructor 0x738010).

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::Rebuild
addresses.comment: Slot 0, what a reload of the interface runs. Hides and frees any old `oobbrowser` window, makes a new one (+0xD0), finds `list` (+0xE0), `split_window` (+0xD4) and its `list` (+0xE4), **hides the split window**, keeps the window's x (+0x170), wires collapse, uncollapse, focus, theatre_forces, split_button (+0x174) and, on the split window, its collapse, uncollapse, match_views and focus buttons. Answers true.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the element names are immediates in the body.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::Open
addresses.comment: Opens the browser: +0xF4 = 1; the list is filled (FillRoots) if it has no rows, else refreshed (RefreshList). `oob_label` = OOB_LABEL with $COUNTRY_ADJ$ the player's adjective. The window's height is screen height minus 260 and `list` keeps the difference; the window is shown and `split_window` hidden. Nothing pauses. One caller, the screen's slot 104.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the decompilation and the listing of 0x6788B0, its caller. Negative: no pause call in the body.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::Close
addresses.comment: Hides the window and the two drag templates, clears the drag state (ClearDrag), +0xF4 = 0, and empties the two CRefs at +0xF8 and +0x120. Callers: the constructor, the screen's slot 104, CInGameIdler::AddUnitRow (two selected), RemoveUnitRow (down to one selected) and CInGameIdler::Update whenever the row count is not 1.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; caller list from a scan of call rel32 to 0x7395E0.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::Update
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBBrowser::Update(COOBBrowser* this, void* mouse, float elapsed)
addresses.comment: Per frame while open (+0xF4). theatre_forces_button is enabled unless a custom game's local player has its record's flag set (CustomGameSettings +0x5C.. + 4, FUN_004208b0); split_button's frame is 2 where the split window is shown, else 1. Both lists are refreshed, the queues cleared, collapse/uncollapse swapped by whether any row is indented. Then the drag: +0x9C 1 -> records the mouse (2); 2 -> a move over 2 pixels on either axis makes it 3; at 3 the dragged unit (+0x20), sub-unit (+0x48) or leader (+0x70) is resolved. Button released: UnitRows_HandleDrop on the main list, else the split list, then ClearDrag. Button held: the list under the mouse scrolls (AutoScroll) and a floating `oob_unit_entry` or `oob_leader_entry` follows the mouse. Each visible row updates (UpdateRow).
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the mouse is the application's +0xE4 object and the float the idler's +0xA8C per the caller 0x656579.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::FillRoots
addresses.comment: **The tree's roots: the player's whole order of battle, not the selected unit's.** Walks the player's country's units (CCountry +0xBAC, list order) and gives every unit whose higher_oob_unit (+0x1E0) is null a row at level 0, appended. Then the list scrolls to the top.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the country is `countries_first[player.id]` in the decompilation.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnCollapse
addresses.comment: collapse_button (+0x178): empties the main list, sets its row-pool count (+0xC8) to 0 and refills the roots.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnCollapseSplit
addresses.comment: The split window's collapse_button (+0x1D0): the same on the split list and its count +0xCC.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnExpandAll
addresses.comment: uncollapse_button (+0x1A4): ExpandAll(this, list 0).

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnExpandAllSplit
addresses.comment: The split window's uncollapse_button (+0x1FC): ExpandAll(this, list 1).

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_ExpandAll
addresses.no_signature: `this` on the stack and the list index in EAX; ret 4. No ordinary convention carries it.
addresses.comment: Empties the list, refills the roots, then each root row gets its whole subtree recursively (AddSubtree), inserted before the next root.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnFocus
addresses.comment: focus_button (+0x228): ScrollToUnit on the main list for the screen's GetSelectedUnit (slot 40).

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnFocusSplit
addresses.comment: The split window's focus_button (+0x254): the same on the split list.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnSplitButton
addresses.comment: split_button (+0x2AC): where the split window is shown it is hidden; otherwise the main list's rows are copied onto the split list (CopyList) and the split window shown. Not present in the base game's file, only Their Finest Hour's.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; `*(char *)(this[+0xD4] + 0x5B)` is the split window's shown byte.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::OnMatchViews
addresses.comment: match_views_button (+0x2D8): CopyList from the main list to the split list. Only ever main to split.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::CopyList
addresses.signature: void __stdcall COOBBrowser::CopyList(COOBBrowser* this, void* source, void* destination)
addresses.comment: Clears `destination` (returning its rows to its pool), then makes a row for each of `source`'s rows at the same level over the same unit, and gives destination the source's scrollbar value where that is not negative.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; callers OnSplitButton and OnMatchViews.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::RefreshList
addresses.comment: Each frame for each list. Any row whose unit no longer resolves empties the list and refills the roots. Then for each entry of the queue +0x158 (units whose place in the tree changed) RepositionUnit, and for each entry of +0x148 (units whose row must be redrawn) the row with that unit is marked dirty (+0x15C) and takes the unit again.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::QueueRowChanged
addresses.comment: Appends a CRef of `unit` to +0x148. Told by CAssignLeaderCommand::Execute, CTransferSubUnitCommand::Execute, CUnitSplitCommand::Execute, CUnitDeployment::JoinUnit and on a leader's rank change: the row's text and pictures are out of date.
addresses.evidence: Listing: `add edi, 0x148` before the push; nine callers listed by a call rel32 scan.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::QueueTreeChanged
addresses.comment: Appends a CRef of `unit` to +0x158. Told by CAttachUnitCommand::Execute, CDetachUnitCommand::Execute, CCreateHigherCommand::Execute, CUnitDeployment::DeployAt and CUnitSplitCommand::Execute: the unit's place in the tree changed.
addresses.evidence: Listing: `add edi, 0x158`; five callers by the same scan.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_RepositionUnit
addresses.no_signature: The list in EDI; stack (browser, unit, parent); ret 0xC.
addresses.comment: Moves or adds a unit's row after a change of parent. Any existing row loses its children rows and leaves the list; with no parent the row is appended at level 0; with a parent whose row is on the list and expanded it goes level parent+1 at the end of the parent's children; otherwise the row is returned to the pool. A selected unit (+4) then ScrollToUnit.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::AddSubtree
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBBrowser::AddSubtree(COOBBrowser* this, CUnit* unit, int level, void* insertBefore, void* list)
addresses.comment: Gives every child of `unit` (CUnit +0x1E4) a row at level+1 and recurses, inserting before `insertBefore` or appending.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::AddChildren
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBBrowser::AddChildren(COOBBrowser* this, CUnit* unit, int level, void* insertBefore, void* list)
addresses.comment: The same as AddSubtree for one level only: one click on an expand button shows the direct children.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_RemoveBelow
addresses.no_signature: The browser in ESI; stack (level, first node, list); ret 0xC.
addresses.comment: Removes the rows that follow while their level is above `level`, returning each to the pool: closing a row.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_ToggleRow
addresses.signature: void __stdcall COOBBrowser_ToggleRow(COOBBrowser* browser, CUnit* unit, int listIndex)
addresses.comment: An expand button pressed or a drag hovering: a row whose next row is deeper is closed (RemoveBelow), otherwise its direct children are added. Scroll position is kept through ListBox_RestoreScroll.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::ScrollToUnit
addresses.no_signature: `this` in ECX, the unit on the stack, the list in EAX; ret 4.
addresses.comment: Only with +0xF5 set: opens every row above the unit (EnsureRowVisible), then sets the list's scroll so the unit's row is the last visible, plus one more row per child row following up to visible-2 of them, floored at 0. Callers: the screen's slot 104, AddUnitRow, the deploy menu's hide and the focus buttons.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the arithmetic is the loop from -rows visible, +1.0 per row, against the 0x170AC0C floor.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::EnsureRowVisible
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBBrowser::EnsureRowVisible(COOBBrowser* this, CUnit* unit, int listIndex)
addresses.comment: Makes the unit's row exist, recursing up its parents: a topmost unit with no row is appended at level 0; a unit whose parent's row is not expanded has the parent's children added.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_UpdateCollapseButtons
addresses.no_signature: The list index in ECX as `this`, the browser on the stack; ret 4.
addresses.comment: For a window that is shown: where any of its rows is indented collapse_button is shown and uncollapse_button hidden, otherwise the reverse. So one label sits on the position the other leaves.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_AutoScroll
addresses.no_signature: The browser in ESI; stack (list index, elapsed, x, y); ret 0x10.
addresses.comment: During a drag: with the mouse's x inside the list, above its top or below its bottom edge, a float counter (+0x168/+0x16C) moves by sqrt(distance) * elapsed; past 1.0 either way the list moves one line and the counter is zero. Inside the list or outside its column the counter is zero.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; IntegerSqrt and the constant at 0x171DBAC, 1.0f.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::BeginDragUnit
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBBrowser::BeginDragUnit(COOBBrowser* this, CUnit* unit, void* deploymentCallback)
addresses.comment: Picks up a unit: null clears the drag; otherwise the CRef at +0x20 is set, +0x9C = 1 and +0x98 = the callback (0 from the browser, from the unit panel's child rows, from the outliner; the deploy menu's mouse observer passes its CDropAndAssignUnitDeploymentCallback). Named by the deploy menu's reading as the routine that lets a unit be dropped on another.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::BeginDragSubUnit
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBBrowser::BeginDragSubUnit(COOBBrowser* this, CSubUnit* subUnit, void* deploymentCallback)
addresses.comment: The same for a brigade, ship or wing: the CRef at +0x48. From CSubUnitEntry and the deploy menu's observer; nothing in the browser itself drags a sub-unit.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser::BeginDragLeader
addresses.comment: The same for a leader: the CRef at +0x70, no callback. From a row's leader_photo (0x736395) and CUnitView::OnLeaderButton (0x76E4C8).
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the id pair read through the leader's +8/+0xC.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_ClearDrag
addresses.no_signature: The browser in ESI; no stack arguments.
addresses.comment: Clears the three CRefs +0x20, +0x48 and +0x70, +0x98 and +0x9C: no drag in progress.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_ClearQueues
addresses.no_signature: The browser in ESI; no stack arguments.
addresses.comment: Empties the two queues +0x148 and +0x158; the frame's refresh has used them.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_TotalWidth
addresses.no_signature: The browser in EDI; answers in EAX.
addresses.comment: The main window's width plus the split window's where it is shown. The single unit panel stands at the browser's x plus this.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the panel's placement at 0x663B7E..0x663BA8, 0x65651A and 0x66553F.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry_BuildTooltip
addresses.signature: bool __fastcall COOBUnitEntry_BuildTooltip(COOBUnitEntry* row@ECX, void* element@EDX, void* out@stack:4) @AL
addresses.comment: A row's tooltip, answering whether it filled it. Over leader_photo: the unit's leader's own tooltip (slot 9), where he exists. Over the row's own window: a coloured §Y leader name, the unit's name and province (each a line), then one line per brigade type held, `%d £%s ` and each brigade's strength as a `{NN` bar in tenths (strength * 10 / max, truncated), then the delayed half OOB_UNDER_COMMAND, how many units of each oob_level are below this one by the words NUM_GROUPS..NUM_UNKNOWNS, a line, and the subtree's brigades by type `%d £%s  `.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the decompilation and the listing of the strength expression at 0x736F57..0x736F8E.

addresses.name: OOB_CountUnderCommand
addresses.comment: Recursive: counts every unit below `unit` into countsByLevel[oob_level]; itself excluded.

addresses.name: OOBEntry_FillUnit
addresses.comment: Fills a row. `unit_name` the unit's name; `unit_info` £type for up to its first five brigades, each followed by a space, with `...` after five where more remain, none for a unit with none; `leader_photo` the leader's portrait gfx/pictures/portraits/%s.tga, shown (the null leader's where there is none); `counter_type` GFX_counter_ + the first brigade's type where intel_level (+0x1F8) is 3 or more and the unit has one, else GFX_counter_ + nothing; `counter_size` by oob_level: frame 6 theatre, 5 army group, 4 army, 3 corps; a division 1 with one brigade and 2 with more; a fleet (level 5) 2; anything else (an air unit, level 6) 1.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; frame = cVar10 + 1 from the switch on +0x1F4.

addresses.name: OOBEntry_FillSubUnit
addresses.no_signature: The window in ECX; the sub-unit on the stack popped by the caller (`add esp, 4` after the call at 0x73A0BC).
addresses.comment: Fills the floating row while a brigade is dragged: `unit_name` the sub-unit's slot 8, `unit_info` empty, GFX_counter_ + its type, counter_size frame 1, leader_photo hidden.

addresses.name: OOBEntry_FillLeader
addresses.comment: Fills `oob_leader_entry`: `leader_name` rank name, a space, the name; `leader_rank` frame the rank; portrait; `leader_info` LEADER_SKILL + ` §Y` + skill + `§b ` + LEADER_XP + ` §Y` + experience 2 decimals + `%`, and where he commands a fleet or air unit, `\n§b ` + LEADER_COMMAND_SIZE, ` §G` or ` §R` by CUnit::LeaderHasRankForCommand, CLeader::CommandSize, a space and SHIPS_LABEL or PLANES_LABEL; `leader_traits` a CTraitEntry per trait (+0x30).
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the separators read from the image at 0x15C3004 etc.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::ScalarDeletingDestructor
addresses.comment: Slot 0 of the primary table. Ghidra's RTTI pass had called this the destructor proper.
addresses.evidence: Calls 0x737880 then frees on bit 0; vtable.py: one holder, COOBUnitEntry slot 0.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::COOBUnitEntry
addresses.no_signature: ECX is the GUI manager (the browser's +0xEC), not the object; stack (row, parent window, browser, list index); ret 0x10.
addresses.comment: Makes a row: the window `oob_unit_entry`, keeping `oob_actual_entry` (+0x54), expand_button (+0x58), drag_button (+0x5C) and leader_photo (+0x64); three glues (+0x68 expand on left click, +0xB8 drag_button left click and press, +0x108 leader_photo left click and press).

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry_SetUnit
addresses.no_signature: The unit in ECX, the row in ESI, the level on the stack; ret 4.
addresses.comment: A row takes a unit and a level, marked dirty.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry_Refresh
addresses.no_signature: The row in ESI; no stack arguments.
addresses.comment: A dirty row: cleared dirty, unit re-resolved, window's x = level * 16 keeping its y, the two counter icons' sprites re-made, OOBEntry_FillUnit.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::Update
addresses.signature: void __thiscall COOBUnitEntry::Update(COOBUnitEntry* this, CUnit* draggedUnit, CUnit* selected, CSubUnit* draggedSubUnit, CLeader* draggedLeader, float elapsed, int anyProvince)
addresses.comment: A row each frame. Refreshes if dirty, dispatches a drag in progress to the three hover routines, otherwise drag_button is enabled, frame 2 for the selected unit's row and 1 for any other, hover time 0. A row's expand button also: frame 2 where the next row is deeper else 1 and shown only where the unit has children (+0x1EC).
addresses.evidence: Read whole, `ret 0x18`. expand frame and show condition from the loop in COOBBrowser::Update at 0x73A470..0x73A4E8.

addresses.name: UnitRow_UpdateUnitDragHover
addresses.signature: void __stdcall UnitRow_UpdateUnitDragHover(void* row, CUnit* dragged, float elapsed)
addresses.comment: A row while a unit is dragged. Not allowed (CUnit_MayTakeSubordinate(this row's unit, dragged, 0)): drag_button frame 1, disabled. Allowed: under the mouse, frame 2 and after a second of hovering a closed row opens (+0x160 past 1.0); otherwise frame 1 and enabled.
addresses.evidence: Read whole, `ret 0xC`, the partner of UnitRow_UpdateSubUnitDragHover (0x336490).

addresses.name: UnitRow_UpdateLeaderDragHover
addresses.signature: void __stdcall UnitRow_UpdateLeaderDragHover(void* row, void* point, CLeader* dragged, float elapsed)
addresses.comment: A row while a leader is dragged. Allowed where the row's unit is not his unit, CUnit::MayTakeLeader(unit, leader, 0), and where the unit has a real leader (slot 8), CUnit::MayTakeLeader(his unit, that leader, 0) - the swap's other half. Under the mouse frame 2, else 1 and disabled when not allowed. The row opens after a second's hover.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry_PointInside
addresses.no_signature: The row in ESI and the point in EDI (x, y).
addresses.comment: Whether the point is strictly inside the row's window.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::OnExpand
addresses.comment: expand_button: COOBBrowser_ToggleRow with this row's unit and list.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::OnDragStart
addresses.comment: Second handler of drag_button's glue. Nothing in a custom game whose local player's record has its flag set; otherwise BeginDragUnit with the row's unit.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::OnLeaderDragStart
addresses.comment: Second handler of leader_photo's glue. The same custom-game gate; otherwise BeginDragLeader with the row's unit's leader.

addresses.name: COOBUnitEntry::OnClick
addresses.comment: First handler of drag_button and leader_photo's glues. Where the unit exists and its slot 2 answers selectable: deselected if selected; follow-selection (+0xF5) off; an open country view closed (screen's slot 93); the selection cleared and this unit selected; the map centred on its province (slot 47, province id +0xD0); +0xF5 back on.

addresses.name: COOBBrowser_ElementTooltip
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall COOBBrowser_ElementTooltip(COOBBrowser* window, CGuiObject* element, GuiTooltipText* out) @EAX
addresses.comment: The browser's element tooltip (the in-game screen's slot 109 asks the window at idler +0x1360). `theatre_forces_button` writes THEATRE_ASSIGN_TROOPS_DESC and answers true; otherwise each visible row of the split list (where its window is shown) and then of the main list is offered it, COOBUnitEntry_BuildTooltip, first to answer true ending it. `ret 0xC`.
addresses.revises: The record called this IdlerWindow1360_ElementTooltip and said the window was not identified: it is COOBBrowser, by the idler's +0x1360 being the browser's constructor's only result and by the two list offsets +0xE0/+0xE4 it reads. Name and comment change; the signature's types are sharpened, the calling convention and arguments are as recorded.
addresses.evidence: Read whole; the element name and key are immediates. What would show it wrong: a second object at +0x1360 - the only write is the constructor's result at 0x65F05E.

addresses.name: COOBChange::Apply
addresses.comment: Slot 7. Sets the country's oob_file (+0x58): forward keeps the old file at +0x2C and takes the new at +0x10; otherwise the +0x2C value is restored.
addresses.evidence: Read the listing arm by arm; `forward`'s meaning from the sibling history entries (CFactionJoin slot 7's record names the same flag) - likely, not confirmed for this class beyond the two arms.

addresses.name: COOBChange::GetKeywordToken
addresses.comment: Slot 6: the token 0x514. One holder.

struct_fields.name: dragged_unit
struct_fields.comment: 0x28 bytes, a CRef with its id and a string: the unit being dragged.

struct_fields.name: dragged_subunit
struct_fields.comment: The brigade, ship or wing being dragged.

struct_fields.name: dragged_leader
struct_fields.comment: The leader being dragged.

struct_fields.name: drop_callback
struct_fields.comment: A deployment-menu callback handed to UnitRows_HandleDrop, or null.
struct_fields.evidence: BeginDragUnit stores it; UnitRows_HandleDrop's record reads it.

struct_fields.name: drag_state
struct_fields.comment: 0 none, 1 picked up, 2 the press point noted, 3 dragging (the mouse moved over 2 pixels on an axis).

struct_fields.name: row_pool
struct_fields.comment: Two vectors of COOBUnitEntry* (0x10 apart): the main list's and the split list's pool.

struct_fields.name: row_pool_used
struct_fields.comment: Two ints: how many rows of each pool are on the list.

struct_fields.name: window
struct_fields.comment: The window `oobbrowser`.

struct_fields.name: split_window
struct_fields.comment: Its child `split_window`.

struct_fields.name: drag_unit_template
struct_fields.comment: The hidden floating `oob_unit_entry`.

struct_fields.name: drag_leader_template
struct_fields.comment: The hidden floating `oob_leader_entry`.

struct_fields.name: list
struct_fields.comment: The main list box.

struct_fields.name: split_list
struct_fields.comment: The split window's list box.

struct_fields.name: idler
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor's second argument, used for GetSelectedUnit.

struct_fields.name: open
struct_fields.comment: Open only sets it and Close clears it; the screen tests it.

struct_fields.name: follow_selection
struct_fields.comment: Cleared by COOBUnitEntry::OnClick around its own select, so selecting from a row does not scroll the list.

struct_fields.name: last_drop_target
struct_fields.comment: Written by UnitRows_HandleDrop on a unit dropped, and cleared by Close. No reader in this class's code; the image was not swept for one.
struct_fields.evidence: The two writers read; the lines at 0x73AE1A.. after the CAttachUnitCommand post.

struct_fields.name: last_dropped_unit
struct_fields.comment: As +0xF8: a copy of the dragged unit's reference.

struct_fields.name: row_changed_queue
struct_fields.comment: A vector of 0x28-byte CRefs: units whose row must be redrawn.

struct_fields.name: tree_changed_queue
struct_fields.comment: A vector of 0x28-byte CRefs: units whose place in the tree changed.

struct_fields.name: scroll_accumulator
struct_fields.comment: Two floats, main and split: AutoScroll's counters.

struct_fields.name: window_x
struct_fields.comment: The window's x when rebuilt.

struct_fields.name: window
struct_fields.comment: `oob_unit_entry`.

struct_fields.name: unit
struct_fields.comment: 0x28 bytes, the unit the row shows.

struct_fields.name: actual_entry
struct_fields.comment: `oob_actual_entry`.

struct_fields.name: level
struct_fields.comment: Depth of the row: x = level * 16.

struct_fields.name: hover_time
struct_fields.comment: Time a drag has hovered the row: past 1.0 opens it.

struct_fields.name: list_index
struct_fields.comment: 0 main list, 1 split list.

slots_noted: COOBUnitEntry's table at +0x1C has its deleting-destructor thunk at 0x73C220 and its other 22 slots shared from CStandardlistboxItem; COOBBrowser slot 1 is the deleting destructor 0x738010, recorded as a slot only.
